summary: I fixed H-design's live Customize defects: Esc now cancels, ⌘Z/⇧⌘Z undo and redo, every tile has its accessibility move/remove actions, and the paused picture is no longer cropped. Each fix is reproduced offscreen. The work-list design items are fixed too: one keycap style on S71, an antialiased System tile, window-control tokens generated from JSON, the onboarding frame-edge strip in mxr-snapshot, and a divider on the scrolling compact palette. All new tests fail in a mutated isolated copy and pass on the tree. The only targeted failure left is FigmaDeviationTests: S17.Sidebar/playback cites D014, which is not accepted. That is another area's entry. swift build is clean.
fixed: LIVE Customize Esc: Esc = Cancel. The Cancel button carries .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction), so the key equivalent reaches it whatever has keyboard focus. The old .onExitCommand only fired with focus inside the dialog, and the window key monitor passes keys through while customizing. An open tile context menu is a key panel with its own cancelOperation, so Esc closes it first. Test: CustomizationKeyboardTests.testEscapeCancelsCustomizeAndDiscardsTheDraft (window.performKeyEquivalent with Esc, offscreen).

LIVE Customize undo: LayoutStore.updateDraft(actionName:) registers each change's inverse on the window's UndoManager. MXRCustomizationView hands that undo manager to the store through a small NSViewRepresentable. Redo works through the re-registration. No-op edits are not undo steps. The session's actions are removed on Save, Cancel and begin, and when the dialog goes away. Edit ▸ Undo reads 'Undo Move Seek Bar' etc. Tests: LayoutUndoTests (MXRCoreTests) and CustomizationKeyboardTests.testWindowUndoAndRedoStepThroughCustomizeEdits (NSWindow undo:/redo:).

LIVE Customize accessibility: every placed tile is one element (.accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)) with the button trait, a 'Move <title>' label and the four move/remove actions. Before, Previous, Next, Audio, Subtitles, Playback Settings, Queue, Menu, Library, Divider and Fullscreen had none. The unlabelled top-bar element is gone. Palette tiles are AXButton instead of AXUnknown. Test: testEveryBarTileExposesTheEditActions.

LIVE Customize aspect-fill (with A-window): PlayerCanvasStyle.resolve returns .underBars for Customize instead of .fullBleed. The canvas still runs under the bars, but the picture keeps the window's picture rect and ends at the new-row band, as Player - customize 2107:5604 draws its video (y 40…972). It no longer fills the window under the bars, which cropped the timecode. Subtitles are no longer covered in Customize (subtitleSafeInset 0). Test: testCustomizeKeepsThePictureBetweenTheBars (vout-probe frame before and during Customize). The S66.App/customization render matches Figma's layout and bars #1A vs #19; its remaining FAIL is the dialog body #15 vs #18, the owner question.

CRITIC S71 two keycap styles: one keycap per binding on every row (⌘F, ⌥⌘←, ⇧⌘R), the way Mac menus write a shortcut. KeyBinding.onboardingKeycap replaces onboardingKeycaps(pairedWithAnother:). D026 amendment updated. Tests: OnboardingShortcutKeycapTests.testKeycapsUseMacGlyphsAndEveryBindingIsOneKeycap and testSingleBindingRowIsOneKeycap. Render: after/S71.png.

CRITIC traffic lights as hand-written constants: Theme.MacWindowControls is now generated by gen-tokens.py from colors.json and metrics.json macWindowControls, both marked 'Not Figma, AppKit buttons, D022'. Sources/MXRDesign/Theme/MacWindowControls.swift is deleted. gen-tokens --check is up to date.

CRITIC onboarding frame-edge strip (with I-build): GalleryCatalog.reference crops of a top-level frame whose box starts between render pixels now restore the outermost rows and columns. A pixel next to an opaque one takes its value (sampling clamped to the box); rounded corners are divided by the bilinear coverage 1−f+f². S71, S69, S70 orange and S70 blue go from FAIL to REVIEW, with 0.000–0.005 % flat colour. I extended the S71 D026 deviation by the keycap shadow (6 pt). Test: GalleryRenderTests.testWholeFrameCropKeepsItsFillAtTheBoxEdges.

PARITY S70 System tile aliasing: a filled half-plane shape (MXRHalfPlane, same token endpoints) replaces the two-stop hard LinearGradient. The diagonal is now antialiased. Evidence: after/S70_system_tile_render_vs_figma.png. Test: testSystemThemeTileDiagonalIsAntialiased.

PARITY S66 compact palette: an overflowing palette ends at DialogDivider above the footer, like every scrolling dialog body (S65/D035), instead of the bottom fade. The fade code (fadeHeight) is removed. Render: after/S66_compact.png. Test: testOverflowingPaletteEndsAtADivider.
PARITY S05/S06 Light thin frame: recorded in D055. With the bars hidden in Light, the frame is Light BG/A3 #D5D5D5, window chrome with no Figma frame.
F-settings notes: the bgB2Transparent token note (colors.json) now says the product draws no scrim and the owner question is open; MXRBackdropSurface docs no longer mention a dialog scrim.

liveChecks.steps: Play S01E01, open View ▸ Customize Player, press Esc without clicking anything. Open it again, right-click a bar tile so its menu opens, then press Esc twice.
liveChecks.expect: The first Esc closes Customize like Cancel and the layout is unchanged. With the tile menu open, the first Esc closes only the menu and the second cancels Customize. ⌘. still goes to the player.

liveChecks.steps: In Customize, right-click the seek bar ▸ Move to New Row, open the Edit menu, then press ⌘Z and then ⇧⌘Z. Cancel, open Customize again and check Edit ▸ Undo.
liveChecks.expect: Edit ▸ Undo is enabled and reads 'Undo Move Seek Bar'. ⌘Z puts the seek bar back in the transport row and ⇧⌘Z moves it to the band again. After Cancel, Undo is grey again.

liveChecks.steps: In Customize, list AX custom actions (tools/ax) for every control-bar and top-bar tile and for the palette tiles.
liveChecks.expect: Every bar tile (Previous, Next, Audio, Subtitles, Playback settings, Queue included) is an AXButton labelled 'Move <name>' with Move to top bar / control bar / new row / Remove from player. No unlabelled AXStaticText in the top bar. Palette tiles are AXButton.

liveChecks.steps: Pause S01E01 (burnt-in timecode top-left), compare the picture before and after View ▸ Customize Player, then Cancel.
liveChecks.expect: The timecode stays fully visible. Top, left and right edges of the picture do not move; only the bottom moves up to the new-row band. No aspect-fill and no crop under the bars. Bars read about #1A over the dark canvas.

liveChecks.steps: Resize the window to 960×540 and open Customize.
liveChecks.expect: The palette scrolls with the indicator visible, and its body ends at a 1 pt divider above Cancel/Save.
